##### Project general facts

Armani Beach Residences by Arada brings together two renowned creative names on a single residential project, with architecture by Tadao Ando and interiors by Armani/Casa. Designed to achieve harmony between architecture, the surrounding seascape and the senses, the building blends traditional Japanese sensibility with contemporary minimalism. It rises above two basement parking levels and a ground floor to nine residential floors and a roof, offering two- to five-bedroom residences, spectacular penthouses and two-level Presidential Suites.

Amenities are led by a residents-only spa with a spacious gym, a sauna, an ice bath and an indoor swimming pool. A lushly landscaped deck features a large-scale infinity pool and a separate children's pool, while a private beach offers food and beverage service, attendants, loungers and umbrellas. A cigar lounge in a library setting, a movie theatre, a children's playroom, a function room with sea views, a double-height lobby with concierge and valet, and parking with electric vehicle charging complete the offer.

Every residence carries high-end Armani/Casa fittings, from designed kitchens and bathrooms to metal profiles, skirting and spotlights, framed by generous ceiling heights. Owners choose between two interior collections: the darker Bridge palette with natural stone, sucupira and oak, or the lighter Checkers palette with precious woods, lacquers and textured glass. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fully equipped kitchens, built-in wardrobes, a maid's room, a guest bathroom and smart home control of climate and lighting.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jumeirah is an iconic man-made island and one of the most prestigious residential addresses in the world, famous for its private beaches, luxury hotels and beach clubs. The palm-shaped island combines exclusive villas and branded residences with waterfront dining, boutique retail and leisure attractions, while the boardwalk and promenades offer spectacular views of the sea and the city skyline.

The Palm Monorail, Al Sufouh Road and Sheikh Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city. Skydive Dubai, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Bluewaters Island are a short drive away, and Nakheel Mall and The Pointe sit within the island. Dubai Media City, Mall of the Emirates and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable reach, as are Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport.

Palm Jumeirah is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most liquid ultra-prime markets in the UAE. Branded beachfront residences designed by world-famous names are in extremely limited supply, attracting high-net-worth buyers from around the world. Strong demand for luxury holiday homes and premium rentals underpins resilient values, high resale potential and long-term capital appreciation for owners.
